name: Anaho Dresser
description: Create your dream bedroom with the exquisite Anaho Dresser. The clean, beveled lines not only give this bureau a neat appearance, but the vivid, acacia brown color adds a distinctive focal point. The entire piece rests on two rectangular, powder-coated metal legs. The traditions of Japanese design are visible in the structure of the Anaho Dresser. Many of our pieces are hand-crafted from natural materials. The beauty is in the natural variations, and will make your piece timeless, authentic, and unique.
